title: The router's citation cue routes a lookup that names a source id beside 'name', 'mention', 'refer' or 'used by' to src --cited, printing a file list instead of the fact
goal: A lookup that names a source id and asks what it says is not routed to the cites expert: rag.py pack 'Which flag name does S1800 give for limiting the number of agentic turns in headless mode?' prints fact lines, not a list of citing files, while rag.py pack 'Which articles cite S1800?' still routes to cites; rag.py eval keeps passing all its rows.

run: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Which flag name does S1800 give for limiting the number of agentic turns in headless mode?'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and 'routed by kind: cites' not in r.stdout and r.stdout.startswith('coverage: ') else 1)

import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','Which articles cite S1800?'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and 'routed by kind: cites' in r.stdout else 1)

import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','What do S1800 and S1801 say about the headless flag used by CI?'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and 'routed by kind: cites' not in r.stdout and r.stdout.startswith('coverage: ') else 1)

notes: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-7n3d4jte on 2026-10-12 (S2): kbfacts.CITE_CUE includes name\w*, mention\w*, refer\w*, us\w* by. Also 'What do S1800 and S1801 say about the headless flag used by CI?' prints a file list; 'What does S1800 say about --max-turns?' is not routed, so the cue words are the cause. Premise run 2026-10-12: the repro pack fails on main and the S1800-and-S1801 pack (check 2) prints a cites file list. Checks 0, 1 and 3 (rag.py eval, the 'Which articles cite S1800?' route, tests -k pack_routes_kind) pass before the work: they pin behaviour that must stay. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 2 of 19, "Lookup correctness: router experts, the tag parser and aliases answer what the kb holds"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.
